terminal.name: Terminal
terminal.description: Shell, DevOps, install, permissions, processes, logs. Requires running commands and reading their output, not design judgement.

patch.name: Patch
patch.description: Fix existing code with a clear, bounded diff: bug with known cause, failing test, small or medium code change. Not for open-ended architecture or unknown-cause debugging.

long-context.name: Long context
long-context.description: Work that needs more than 200K tokens of context, a whole repository, PDFs, images, or many files. Not for short questions.

muse-cheap.name: Muse cheap
muse-cheap.description: General tasks, including private code, where Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor is acceptable. Contributor may train on data; use is the user's choice.
